options: Give it a shot. It's worth the effort.

listen.script: Noura: Have you seen my glasses? I can't find them anywhere. Fahad: You were reading in the garden this morning. They must be out there. Noura: No, I've already looked high and low in the garden. Fahad: Then they might be in the car.

If you ask me, the best place to visit in winter is AlUla. The rocks will take your breath away, and you can try a balloon ride at sunrise. It's not cheap, but it's worth every riyal. You really should book early because hotels fill up fast.
listen.q: Why does the speaker say you should book early?
options: The weather is bad in summer.

listen.script: I wish I had planned our desert trip better. We ran out of water by lunchtime, and the car nearly ran out of fuel too. We should have filled up in the last town. Still, it could have been worse. A kind family stopped and helped us.

Here's how the bottles are recycled. First, they're collected and taken to a plant. Then they're separated from paper and metal and washed. After that, they're broken down into tiny pieces. Finally, the pieces are melted down and made into new things like T-shirts.
listen.q: What happens straight after the bottles are washed?
options: They are broken down into pieces.

read.passage: Last year, Reem left her science project to the last minute. The night before the deadline, her laptop crashed, and she lost everything. 'I could kick myself,' she says. 'I should have saved my work online.' She had to start again and finished at three in the morning. In hindsight, Reem thinks the problem was a blessing in disguise. Her teacher noticed how tired she was and walked her through a better way to plan her work, step by step. Now Reem uses a planner app, which she says has been a game changer. 'If you ask me, every student should try it,' she says. 'It's easier than it sounds, and you'll get the hang of it in a day.'

qs.q: What should Reem have done, according to her?
Why does Reem call the problem a blessing in disguise?
options: She didn't have to finish the project.
She got a better mark than before.
Her teacher taught her a better way to plan.

qs.q: What does Reem recommend to other students?
options: working until three in the morning

qs.q: The phrase 'get the hang of it' means …
options: to learn how to use it
to keep it in a safe place
